name: DRAM 3219
title: Sound Technology and Production Audio
description: Introduction to the characteristics and properties of sound, as well as the design, assembly, and operation of audio systems for the theatre and live entertainment.
requirement_description: DRAM 1216; open to soph or higher; open only to Dramatic Arts majors, others with instructor consent. Students are responsible for purchasing the latest version of Adobe's Creative Cloud for education apps and installing it on their PC.
